title: Chrome advances WebGPU visuals as Google releases Nano Banana 2.1
summary: Chrome's October 7 WebGPU update adds more control over depth, compressed textures, and color. Google's October 6 Gemini API release brings a new image-generation model into general availability.
imageAlt: Illustration of a browser graphics canvas beside an image-generation frame, linked by flowing lines
imageCaption: Original illustration of browser rendering and image generation; the two releases are independent.

sections.heading: Chrome gives WebGPU more precise depth control
paragraphs: Chrome's October 7 overview of WebGPU changes for versions 155–156 introduces the WGSL `fragment_depth` extension. A fragment shader that writes `@builtin(frag_depth)` can normally prevent early depth rejection. By declaring that its output is `less` or `greater` than the interpolated depth, a shader can give the GPU enough information to preserve that optimization where applicable. This is a rendering option, not an automatic speedup for every scene.

The extension is not something to assume across browsers or devices. Chrome's example checks `navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures` for `fragment_depth` before compiling a shader that requires it. Applications depending on it still need a fallback path.

sections.heading: Texture dimensions and wide-gamut output get new options
paragraphs: The same Chrome update describes the optional `texture-compression-unaligned` GPU feature. When available and requested on the device, it permits BC, ETC2, or ASTC compressed textures whose dimensions are not multiples of their compression block size. That can spare asset pipelines from padding or resizing an image merely to satisfy a block boundary; support must first be checked on the adapter.

Chrome also lists `srgb-linear` and `display-p3-linear` canvas color spaces. Its example configures a WebGPU canvas with `rgba16float` and `display-p3-linear`, giving graphics applications a route to linear-light rendering with wider color output. The result still depends on the browser, device, and display rather than the color-space setting alone.

sections.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 reaches general availability
paragraphs: Google's Gemini API release notes say `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` became generally available on October 6. Google describes improvements over Nano Banana 2 in visual quality, prompt following, character consistency across edits, and text rendering. The release also adds wide and panoramic aspect ratios—`1:4`, `4:1`, `1:8`, and `8:1`—at 1K, 2K, and 4K resolutions. These are Google's release claims, not an independent quality comparison.

The notes also deprecate the previous `gemini-3.1-flash-image` model but do not announce a shutdown date. Existing integrations should therefore plan and test a model-ID migration rather than assume that the old endpoint has already stopped working.

sections.heading: What this means for visual web products
paragraphs: These are separate updates: the Gemini model generates or edits image assets through an API, while WebGPU renders graphics in the browser. Together they point to more choices for visual products, but neither announcement supplies a ready-made integration between the two.

A practical evaluation would test the image model against a small set of real prompts and edits, then measure a WebGPU presentation on supported devices with fallbacks in place. That is an implementation suggestion based on the releases, not a performance or quality result reported by either vendor.

zh-TW.title: Chrome 擴充 WebGPU 視覺功能，Google 發布 Nano Banana 2.1
zh-TW.summary: Chrome 10 月 7 日的 WebGPU 更新，讓開發者更細緻地處理深度、壓縮紋理與色彩；Google 則在 10 月 6 日讓新的 Gemini 圖像模型正式推出。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 瀏覽器繪圖畫布與圖像生成相框並列，由流動線條連接的插畫
zh-TW.imageCaption: 本站原創插畫，呈現瀏覽器渲染與圖像生成；兩項發布彼此獨立。

sections.heading: Chrome 讓 WebGPU 能更精確地控制深度
paragraphs: Chrome 在 10 月 7 日整理了 155 至 156 版的 WebGPU 更新，其中包含 WGSL 的 `fragment_depth` 擴充功能。片段著色器若自行寫入 `@builtin(frag_depth)`，通常會妨礙 GPU 提前排除被遮擋的像素。現在可宣告輸出深度相對於插值深度是 `less` 或 `greater`，讓 GPU 在適用情況下保留這項最佳化。這是額外的渲染控制，不代表所有場景都會自動變快。
這項擴充功能不能預設所有瀏覽器與裝置都支援。Chrome 的範例會先透過 `navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures` 檢查 `fragment_depth`，再編譯需要它的著色器；依賴此功能的網站仍應準備替代路徑。

sections.heading: 壓縮紋理尺寸與廣色域輸出有了新選項
paragraphs: 同一份更新也介紹了選用的 `texture-compression-unaligned` GPU 功能。當裝置支援且應用程式明確請求時，BC、ETC2 或 ASTC 壓縮紋理的尺寸不必再是壓縮區塊大小的整數倍。素材流程因此可能不必只為了對齊區塊而替圖片補邊或縮放；使用前仍須先檢查轉接器是否支援。
Chrome 也列出 `srgb-linear` 與 `display-p3-linear` 畫布色彩空間。官方範例將 WebGPU 畫布設定為 `rgba16float` 和 `display-p3-linear`，讓圖形應用程式能選擇線性光運算與更廣的色彩輸出。實際顯示效果仍取決於瀏覽器、裝置與螢幕，不是設定色彩空間就能保證。

sections.heading: Nano Banana 2.1 正式推出
paragraphs: Google 的 Gemini API 更新紀錄指出，`gemini-nano-banana-2.1` 已於 10 月 6 日正式推出。Google 表示，相較 Nano Banana 2，新模型在視覺品質、遵循提示、多輪編輯時維持角色一致性，以及文字呈現方面都有改進；也支援 `1:4`、`4:1`、`1:8` 與 `8:1` 等寬幅比例，解析度涵蓋 1K、2K、4K。這些是 Google 的發布說明，並非本站獨立測得的品質比較。
更新紀錄同時將舊版 `gemini-3.1-flash-image` 標記為棄用，但沒有公告停止服務日期。既有串接應規劃並測試模型 ID 的遷移，不必把棄用誤解為舊端點已經停用。

sections.heading: 對視覺型網頁產品的意義
paragraphs: 這是兩項獨立更新：Gemini 模型透過 API 產生或編輯圖像素材，WebGPU 則負責在瀏覽器中渲染圖形。它們都增加了視覺產品的選擇，但官方公告並沒有提供兩者現成的整合方案。
若要評估實際用途，可以先用少量真實提示與編輯情境測試圖像模型，再於支援的裝置上測量 WebGPU 呈現效果並保留替代方案。這是根據更新提出的實作建議，不是任何一方公布的效能或品質測試結果。
